caption: The drawing depicts a single round fruit, likely an apple, placed on a shallow dish or saucer at the center of the composition. The apple displays a mix of green and red colors with irregular patches and streaks, and it has a brown stem. The dish underneath the apple is rendered in shades of gray and white, with some reflections of the apple's colors on its surface. A strong, dark shadow from the apple and saucer falls to the right of the objects, suggesting a light source coming from the upper left. The background is a plain off-white divided by a horizontal line, creating the appearance of a surface and wall, and the drawing is framed by a faint rectangular border. The predominant colors are green, red, brown, gray, white, and black.
